description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and TFLOPs for two models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.28e9, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25e9. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” with a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05.  The Vanilla model is represented by a purple line with triangular markers, decreasing from a loss of approximately 2.72 at 0.0 TFLOPs to approximately 2.52 at 1.28e9 TFLOPs, with slight fluctuations in between. The SepLLM model is represented by a red line with circular markers; it begins at a loss of approximately 2.68 at 0.0 TFLOPs, decreases to 2.51 at approximately 0.75 TFLOPs, then fluctuates between approximately 2.51 and 2.48, ending at approximately 2.48 at 1.28e9 TFLOPs. A horizontal dashed green line is present at a y-value of 2.50.
